title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
title_zh: Squaring-the-Sphere：基于CubeAtlas的无失真无缝全景生成

paragraphs.en: Generating 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere , a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas , which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.
paragraphs.zh: 生成 360 度全景图需要同时满足局部透视保真度和全局球面连续性。 现有表示方法面临权衡：等距柱状投影（ERP）能够实现无缝的全景建模，但存在严重畸变以及与预训练图像生成器之间的域差距；而立方体贴图虽能保留透视几何，但常产生不一致的面和明显的接缝。 我们提出 Squaring-the-Sphere，这是一个基于全新表示 CubeAtlas 的全景图像生成框架，它将所有立方体贴图面展开到一张紧凑的画布上。 通过将与朝向对齐、经过旋转的极地区域与赤道面并列排布，这种表示既保留了立方体贴图的透视几何，又组织了无缝全景拼接所需的跨面关系。 它还使预训练的扩散Transformer能够在单次传递中联合建模完整全景，而无需更改主干架构或位置编码。 虽然 CubeAtlas 的token数量与 ERP 相当，但其结构化布局使许多密集注意力交互变得不再必要。 因此，我们引入了一种布局感知的稀疏注意力掩码，它在保留全景连续性所需交互的同时，移除几何上无关的token对。 结果表明，CubeAtlas 以更低的注意力计算量实现了优于 ERP 建模的质量。 此外，我们提出了一种无需训练的超分辨率技术和一种融合方案，在生成最终 ERP 全景图之前，在无畸变的透视空间中增强细节。 在多个基准上的实验表明，与以往方法相比，我们的方法在几何保真度、跨视角一致性和高分辨率视觉质量方面均有提升。

paragraphs.en: 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramas serve as a fundamental visual medium for a broad range of immersive applications, including virtual and augmented reality, gaming, telepresence, and 3D world modeling ( HunyuanWorld et al., 2025 ; HY-World Team et al., 2026 ; World Labs, 2025 ; Ji et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . Recent advances in image generative models have substantially improved the realism, diversity, and controllability of perspective image synthesis ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . However, how to transfer the powerful generative priors learned in perspective space to panorama generation remains an open challenge, as a panorama must simultaneously preserve local perspective fidelity and maintain globally coherent, seamless content over the entire sphere ( Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we identify the key challenge as selecting a panoramic representation compatible with pre-trained image priors. The two most common choices are equirectangular projection (ERP) and cubemaps. ERP represents the scene on a single equirectangular canvas, facilitating joint modeling of the entire panorama ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . However, its non-uniform spherical projection severely stretches polar regions, introduces geometric distortion, and departs from the perspective-image distribution learned by modern generators ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . Cubemaps avoid ERP’s polar stretching by decomposing the sphere into six perspective faces ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Kalischek et al., 2025 ) . Although methods such as CubeDiff jointly model these faces through cross-face attention, preserving spatial continuity across face boundaries remains challenging. Therefore, unifying ERP’s global coherence with cubemaps’ perspective fidelity remains a central problem for high-quality panorama generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将关键挑战确定为选择一种与预训练图像先验兼容的全景表示。 最常见的两种选择是等距柱状投影（ERP）和立方体贴图。 ERP 在单张等距柱状画布上表示场景，便于对整个全景进行联合建模（Zhang et al., 2024；Feng et al., 2023；Wu et al., 2026；Huang et al., 2026）。 然而，其非均匀的球面投影会严重拉伸极地区域，引入几何畸变，并偏离现代生成器所学习到的透视图像分布（Liang et al., 2026）。 立方体贴图通过将球体分解为六个透视面来避免 ERP 的极区拉伸问题（Tang et al., 2023；Kalischek et al., 2025）。 尽管诸如 CubeDiff 之类的方法通过跨面注意力对这些面进行联合建模，但在面边界之间保持空间连续性仍然具有挑战性。 因此，将 ERP 的全局一致性与立方体贴图的透视保真度统一起来，仍然是高质量全景生成的核心问题。

paragraphs.en: To address this trade-off, we propose Squaring-the-Sphere , a framework built on a new panorama representation termed CubeAtlas . Rather than generating an ERP image or six independent cube faces, Squaring-the-Sphere unfolds the complete cubemaps into a single image-like grid and enables a diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) to model the entire panorama jointly in one forward pass, as illustrated by the CubeAtlas layout in the upper part of Figure 1 . By combining half-polar rotation and packing for seam-aware yet compact face alignment with layout-aware sparse attention for efficient token interactions, Squaring-the-Sphere promotes cross-view continuity without the cost of dense global attention. Crucially, our representation is compatible with existing DiT-based image generators without modifying their backbone architectures or positional encodings, thereby inheriting large-scale 2D image priors with minimal adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一权衡问题，我们提出 Squaring-the-Sphere，这是一个建立在名为 CubeAtlas 的新型全景表示之上的框架。 Squaring-the-Sphere 不再生成 ERP 图像或六个独立的立方体面，而是将完整的立方体贴图展开为单个类图像网格，并使扩散 Transformer（DiT）（Peebles and Xie, 2023）能够在一次前向传播中对整个全景进行联合建模，如图 1 上半部分的 CubeAtlas 布局所示。 通过将半极旋转与打包相结合，实现兼顾接缝感知且紧凑的面片对齐，并利用布局感知的稀疏注意力实现高效的 token 交互，Squaring-the-Sphere 在无需付出稠密全局注意力代价的情况下促进了跨视图的连续性。 至关重要的是，我们的表示与现有的基于 DiT 的图像生成器兼容，无需修改其骨干架构或位置编码，从而以最小的适配代价继承了大规模 2D 图像先验。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, CubeAtlas re-arranges the six cubemap faces into a compact three-band, four-column layout, as detailed in Figure 2 . For each equatorial orientation, it retains only the equator-adjacent half of the upper and lower faces, rotated to align with the corresponding equatorial view. This half-polar layout retains the local context needed to connect each polar region to its neighboring equatorial faces while avoiding redundant polar tokens; complementary rotated copies are later combined to reconstruct the complete polar faces. Polar rotation aligns polar content with the corresponding equatorial views, turning otherwise discontinuous cross-face relationships into locally organized neighborhoods within the grid, thereby facilitating seamless grid-to-ERP assembly. We further introduce layout-aware sparse attention that preserves the intra-face and continuity-related interactions required for panorama generation while masking irrelevant token pairs. Specifically, full attention is retained within each latitude band for horizontal consistency, while cross-latitude communication is mediated solely by the equatorial band: upper and lower regions never interact directly, and each equatorial region attends only to the polar regions on the same left–right or front–back axis. Finally, we reproject the ERP into overlapping perspective cube views and apply a training-free 4 × 4\times super-resolution model ( Lu et al., 2026a ) to each view. Low-frequency correction preserves coherent color and illumination in the final ERP, while linear blending of overlaps solves discontinuities.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，CubeAtlas 将六个立方体贴图面重新排列为紧凑的三行四列布局，详见图 2。 对于每个赤道朝向，它仅保留上面和下面中邻近赤道的那一半，并旋转以与相应的赤道视图对齐。 这种半极区布局保留了将每个极区与其相邻赤道面连接起来所需的局部上下文，同时避免了冗余的极区 token；互补的旋转副本随后会被合并，以重建完整的极区面。 极区旋转使极区内容与相应的赤道视图对齐，将原本不连续的跨面关系转化为网格内局部组织的邻域，从而促进无缝的网格到 ERP 组装。 我们进一步引入布局感知的稀疏注意力，在保留全景生成所需的面内交互和连续性相关交互的同时，屏蔽无关的 token 对。 具体来说，每个纬度带内保留完整注意力以保证水平一致性，而跨纬度通信仅由赤道带中介：上部和下部区域从不直接交互，且每个赤道区域只关注同一左右轴或前后轴上的极区。 最后，我们将 ERP 重投影为重叠的透视立方体视图，并对每个视图应用免训练的 4 × 4\times 超分辨率模型（Lu et al., 2026a）。 低频校正保证了最终 ERP 中连贯的颜色和光照，而对重叠区域的线性融合则解决了不连续性问题。

paragraphs.en: CubeAtlas representation is proposed that unfolds an entire cubemap into a single compact canvas with orientation-aligned half-polar regions. It retains only the equator-adjacent portions of rotated polar copies to reduce redundant polar tokens while preserving the context required for full polar reconstruction. The representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps, while resolving cross-face discontinuities, enabling seamless panorama generation and direct reuse of 2D image priors from pre-trained DiT generators.

paragraphs.en: 360 ∘ Panorama Generation. Existing panorama generators are largely distinguished by how they represent the sphere ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . ERP-based methods synthesize a single canvas, which facilitates global generation ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2023 ) , but polar stretching creates a mismatch with the perspective-image distribution of pretrained generators. Panorama-specific adaptations address this mismatch through seam-aware processing ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) or hybrid perspective–panorama training ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Cubemap-based methods instead preserve perspective geometry while explicitly adapting the model to communicate across separate faces. CubeDiff ( Kalischek et al., 2025 ) jointly denoises six faces through inflated attention and augments their latents with spherical UV coordinates, while DreamCube ( Huang et al., 2025 ) uses spherical coordinates and synchronizes attention to improve boundary consistency. Although both support joint generation within a single forward pass, they retain separate face-wise spatial grids and introduce panorama-specific positional signals or operators to mitigate cross-face seams. Our method instead packs orientation-aligned cubemap faces into a single CubeAtlas canvas, turning cross-face adjacencies into local 2D neighborhoods and enabling seam-consistent panorama generation with the pretrained DiT’s native positional encoding and backbone structure.
paragraphs.zh: 360 度全景图生成。 现有全景图生成器的区别主要体现在如何表示球面（Xia et al., 2026）。 基于 ERP 的方法合成单一画布，便于全局生成（Chen et al., 2022; Zhang et al., 2024; Feng et al., 2023），但极点拉伸导致其与预训练生成器的透视图像分布不匹配。 针对全景图的特定改进通过接缝感知处理（Wu et al., 2026; Kang et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2026b）或透视—全景混合训练（Feng et al., 2026）来解决这一不匹配问题。 基于 cubemap 的方法则保留透视几何结构，同时显式地调整模型以在不同面之间进行信息传递。 CubeDiff（Kalischek et al., 2025）通过膨胀注意力对六个面进行联合去噪，并用球面 UV 坐标增强其潜变量；而 DreamCube（Huang et al., 2025）使用球面坐标并同步注意力以提升边界一致性。 尽管二者都支持在单次前向传播中联合生成，但它们仍保留各自按面划分的空间网格，并引入全景图特有的位置信号或算子来缓解跨面接缝问题。 我们的方法则将方向对齐的 cubemap 各面打包到单一的 CubeAtlas 画布中，把跨面相邻关系转化为局部二维邻域，从而利用预训练 DiT 原生的位置编码和骨干结构实现接缝一致的全景图生成。

paragraphs.en: Image-to-Panorama Generation. Image-to-panorama methods extend a narrow-field perspective image into a complete environment. Earlier diffusion-based approaches typically formulate the task as panoramic outpainting, using camera-aware projection and inpainting to align the conditioning image with an ERP target ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . More recently, 360Anything ( Wu et al., 2026 ) and HY-Pano 2.0 ( HY-World Team et al., 2026 ) learn the perspective-to-ERP mapping directly from data in a geometry-free manner, without explicit camera metadata or camera calibration. Squaring-the-Sphere shares this geometry-free formulation: it consumes the conditioning image as-is, without camera calibration, explicit input projection, or geometric inpainting. Unlike methods that directly generate ERP, it learns this mapping in the CubeAtlas, whose perspective-aligned layout is better matched to the target image prior.

paragraphs.en: Priors from Generative Image Models. Large-scale diffusion and flow-based image generators ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) provide strong priors for high-fidelity, controllable perspective-image synthesis. Directly transferring these planar priors to ERP panoramas is nevertheless non-trivial: their standard spatial representations do not encode spherical periodicity or polar convergence. Recent training-free adaptations, e.g., SpheRoPE ( Hirschorn et al., 2026 ) and SphereDiff ( Park et al., 2026 ) , modify positional encoding or use spherical projection at inference time to inject these spherical constraints into frozen generators ( Hayakawa et al., 2026 ) . Such methods demonstrate the useful panoramic priors already present in foundation models, but their generation capability must still be induced at inference time rather than learned in a panorama-specific representation. Squaring-the-Sphere instead fine-tunes a pre-trained generative DiT on CubeAtlas formulations, preserving its perspective-image prior while learning joint cross-face generation in a representation designed for panoramic continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 来自生成式图像模型的先验。 大规模的扩散与流（flow-based）图像生成器（Esser et al., 2024；Black Forest Labs, 2024；Wu et al., 2025）为高保真、可控的透视图像合成提供了强大的先验。 然而，将这些平面先验直接迁移到 ERP 全景图并非易事：它们的标准空间表示既不编码球面周期性，也不编码极点收敛性。 近期的免训练适配方法，例如 SpheRoPE（Hirschorn et al., 2026）和 SphereDiff（Park et al., 2026），在推理阶段修改位置编码或使用球面投影，从而将这些球面约束注入冻结的生成器（Hayakawa et al., 2026）。 这类方法证明了基础模型中已经存在有用的全景先验，但其生成能力仍然必须在推理阶段诱导出来，而不是在面向全景的表示中学习得到。 Squaring-the-Sphere 则改为在 CubeAtlas 公式化框架上微调预训练的生成式 DiT，在保留其透视图像先验的同时，于一个为全景连续性而设计的表示中学习跨面的联合生成。

paragraphs.en: A panorama captures a complete 360 ∘ × 180 ∘ 360^{\circ}\times 180^{\circ} view of a scene from a fixed viewpoint, and the choice of how to lay this view out on a flat image plane has a decisive effect on generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 全景图从一个固定视点捕捉场景完整的 360^{\circ}\times 180^{\circ} 视野，而如何将这一视野布局到平面图像上，对生成质量具有决定性影响。

paragraphs.en: Equirectangular Projection (ERP). ERP maps longitude and latitude onto the horizontal and vertical axes of a 2 : 1 2:1 rectangular image, providing a simple and compact representation of the full sphere. However, its sampling becomes increasingly non-uniform toward the poles, causing severe horizontal stretching and departing from the perspective-image domain of pretrained diffusion models. This mismatch makes it difficult to generate faithful geometry in polar regions. Moreover, spherical continuity is split across the left and right image boundaries, requiring explicit handling of horizontal wrap-around.
paragraphs.zh: 等距柱状投影（ERP）。 ERP 将经度和纬度映射到 2 : 1 2:1 矩形图像的横轴和纵轴上，为整个球体提供了简单而紧凑的表示。 然而，其采样在靠近两极处变得越来越不均匀，导致严重的水平拉伸，并偏离了预训练扩散模型所处的透视图像域。 这种不匹配使得在极地区域难以生成忠实的几何结构。 此外，球面连续性在图像的左右边界处被切断，需要对水平环绕进行显式处理。

However, content that is continuous on the sphere is split across separate face boundaries. Without effective cross-face modeling, generated faces can become inconsistent in appearance, semantics, and geometry, resulting in visible seams along cube edges.

paragraphs.en: To unify both advantages, we propose a new representation that retains the perspective-face geometry of cubemaps while organizing their cross-face relationships into a single image-like canvas. Let S S denote the side length of each cube face in latent space. The four equatorial orientations ( L , F , R , B \mathrm{L},\mathrm{F},\mathrm{R},\mathrm{B} ) are placed side by side in the central band. Jointly denoising this complete band in one forward pass allows the model to learn the horizontal continuity directly.

paragraphs.en: We build Squaring-the-Sphere on a pre-trained image-editing DiT. paragraphs.en: Although the CubeAtlas canvas has a token count comparable to that of ERP, dense attention over all its regions is not always necessary to maintain panoramic consistency. A key advantage of CubeAtlas is that it makes geometrically adjacent faces locally connected while retaining a structured decomposition of the panorama. paragraphs.zh: 尽管 CubeAtlas 画布的 token 数量与 ERP 相当，但对所有区域进行稠密注意力并非维持全景一致性所必需。 CubeAtlas 的一个关键优势在于，它在保留全景图结构化分解的同时，使几何上相邻的面在局部相互连接。 我们利用这一特性，在目标到目标的交互上采用布局感知的稀疏注意力掩码；文本与条件 token 则与每个目标 token 保持全局连接。

sents.zh: 我们利用这一特性，在目标到目标的交互上采用布局感知的稀疏注意力掩码；文本与条件 token 则与每个目标 token 保持全局连接。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we partition the target into upper, equatorial, and lower bands. We retain full attention within each band to preserve horizontal consistency, but block direct interactions between the upper and lower polar bands. For cross-latitude communication, each equatorial face attends only to the polar half-regions aligned with its axis. For example, L \mathrm{L} attends to { U L , U R , D L , D R } \{\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{R}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{R}}\} , whose complementary halves reconstruct its neighboring upper and lower faces. Conversely, a polar query attends to all equatorial keys, allowing the equatorial band to serve as the cross-latitude bridge. Overall, the layout-aware mask retains 75 % 75\% of the target-to-target attention connectivity of dense attention, as illustrated in Figure 3 , while text and image-conditioning tokens remain globally connected to all target tokens. Blocking direct attention between some regions does not prevent information exchange: features can still propagate through the equatorial band across successive DiT layers. The mask therefore structures cross-region communication rather than separating the panorama into independently modeled regions. Our experiments further show that this structured sparsity supports cross-view consistency while improving efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们将目标划分为上部、赤道和下部三个带状区域。 我们在每个带状区域内保留完整的注意力以维持水平方向的一致性，但阻断上部与下部极地带状区域之间的直接交互。 对于跨纬度通信，每个赤道面仅关注与其轴对齐的极地半区域。 例如，L \mathrm{L} 关注 { U L , U R , D L , D R } \{\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{R}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{L}},\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{R}}\} ，其互补的半区域可重构其相邻的上部和下部面。 反之，一个极地查询会关注所有赤道键，使赤道带充当跨纬度的桥梁。 总体而言，如图 3 所示，这种布局感知掩码保留了密集注意力中目标到目标注意力连接的 75 % 75\% ，而文本和图像条件令牌仍与所有目标令牌保持全局连接。 阻断某些区域之间的直接注意力并不会阻止信息交换：特征仍可在相继的 DiT 层之间通过赤道带传播。 因此，该掩码是对跨区域通信进行结构化组织，而不是将全景图分割为独立建模的区域。 我们的实验进一步表明，这种结构化稀疏性在提升效率的同时支持了跨视图一致性。

paragraphs.en: To obtain high-resolution panoramas without heavy training, we apply a frozen 4 × 4\times Pixel Diffusion Decoder (PiD) ( Lu et al., 2026a ) in perspective space. Specifically, the fused ERP is reprojected into six overlapping cubemap views with an enlarged FoV of 92.79 ∘ 92.79^{\circ} , which are independently enhanced by PiD and mapped back to the ERP domain. This process upsamples the base panorama by 4 × 4\times along each spatial dimension, producing 10k ERP panoramas. We linearly blend overlapping regions outside the FoV range of 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} to suppress cross-view discontinuities. Since generative super-resolution may introduce low-frequency shifts, we further apply a correction strategy ( Yue et al., 2025 ) to anchor the global color and illumination to the base panorama while retaining the generated high-frequency details.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares Squaring-the-Sphere with representative panorama generation systems. The metrics cover distributional fidelity (FID, KID, and CLIP-FID), ERP and cubemap boundary continuity (Seam ERP {}_{\text{ERP}} , Seam Cube {}_{\text{Cube}} ), equatorial and polar perceptual and geometric quality (Eq-* and Pole-*), and prompt adherence (TextAdh); full definitions are provided in Appendix D . Squaring-the-Sphere achieves the lowest Seam Cube {}_{\text{Cube}} on all four benchmarks, reducing the cube-edge error by 63 63 – 78 % 78\% relative to CubeDiff. These results support the effectiveness of generating a single canvas directly to eliminate cross-face discontinuities. Note that at Seam ERP {}_{\text{ERP}} values around 0.01 0.01 , further numerical differences may not translate into perceptible differences in boundary seams. We therefore interpret this metric together with the qualitative comparisons. Squaring-the-Sphere also leads Eq-GI and Pole-GI on every benchmark and ranks first or second in Pole-IQ, demonstrating improved equatorial and polar geometry. Meanwhile, it achieves the best CLIP-FID on all three public benchmarks, leads FID and KID on RealSee3D and FID on Laval-Indoor, and obtains the highest TextAdh. paragraphs.en: We presented Squaring-the-Sphere , a representation-driven framework for text-guided image-to-panorama generation. Its CubeAtlas representation jointly generates a compact grid of equatorial faces and rotated half-polar regions, combining cubemap perspective geometry with global continuity while retaining an ERP-like token count. Layout-aware sparse attention further removes unnecessary cross-region interactions, and geometry-free conditioning transfers pretrained image priors without camera calibration or architectural modification. A training-free perspective-space super-resolution stage produces the final high-resolution ERP. Across diverse benchmarks, Squaring-the-Sphere improves seam continuity and spherical geometry while preserving visual fidelity and text adherence. These results highlight panorama representation as a simple and effective route for adapting generative image models to omnidirectional synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Squaring-the-Sphere，一个由表示驱动的框架，用于文本引导的图像到全景图生成。 其 CubeAtlas 表示联合生成由赤道面和旋转的半极区组成的紧凑网格，将立方体贴图的透视几何与全局连续性相结合，同时保持类似 ERP 的词元数量。 布局感知的稀疏注意力进一步去除了不必要的跨区域交互，而无几何条件的控制方式无需相机标定或架构修改即可迁移预训练图像先验。 无需训练的透视空间超分辨率阶段生成最终的高分辨率 ERP。 在多个基准测试中，Squaring-the-Sphere 在保持视觉保真度和文本一致性的同时，改善了接缝连续性和球面几何。 这些结果凸显了全景表示作为将生成式图像模型适配于全向合成的简单而有效的途径。

paragraphs.en: Our current model is trained and evaluated at a fixed base resolution and does not explicitly support arbitrary-resolution generation. In practice, however, the perspective-space super-resolution pipeline produces panoramas up to 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 resolution, which is sufficient for most downstream applications and makes output resolution unlikely to be a practical bottleneck. As a generative model, Squaring-the-Sphere also depends on the quality of its textual conditioning. We observe that accurate and detailed captions provide substantially stronger semantic guidance, particularly for regions that are not visible in the input perspective image, whereas vague or incomplete descriptions may lead to less coherent or less controllable generations. More fundamentally, generating a complete 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} environment from a single perspective observation is inherently under-constrained. Content outside the observed FoV must be synthesized rather than faithfully recovered, and multiple plausible panoramas may correspond to the same input image. Finally, our current study focuses on static panoramas. Extending CubeAtlas to temporally consistent panoramic video and interactive scene generation remains an interesting direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们当前的模型是在固定的基础分辨率上进行训练和评估的，并不显式支持任意分辨率的生成。 然而，在实践中，透视空间超分辨率流水线能够生成高达 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 分辨率的全景图，这足以满足大多数下游应用的需求，因此输出分辨率不太可能成为实际瓶颈。 作为一种生成模型，Squaring-the-Sphere 同样依赖于文本条件化的质量。 我们观察到，准确且详细的字幕能够提供明显更强的语义引导，尤其是对于输入透视图像中不可见的区域；而模糊或不完整的描述可能导致生成结果连贯性较差或可控性较差。 更根本的是，从单一透视观测生成完整的 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 环境本质上是欠约束的。 视场之外的内容必须通过合成来生成，而非忠实地还原，并且同一张输入图像可能对应多幅合理的全景图。 最后，我们目前的研究聚焦于静态全景图。 将 CubeAtlas 扩展到时间上一致的全景视频和交互式场景生成，是未来工作中有趣的方向。

sents.en: In practice, however, the perspective-space super-resolution pipeline produces panoramas up to 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 resolution, which is sufficient for most downstream applications and makes output resolution unlikely to be a practical bottleneck.
sents.zh: 然而，在实践中，透视空间超分辨率流水线能够生成高达 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 分辨率的全景图，这足以满足大多数下游应用的需求，因此输出分辨率不太可能成为实际瓶颈。

sents.en: As a generative model, Squaring-the-Sphere also depends on the quality of its textual conditioning.
sents.zh: 作为一种生成模型，Squaring-the-Sphere 同样依赖于文本条件化的质量。

sents.en: We observe that accurate and detailed captions provide substantially stronger semantic guidance, particularly for regions that are not visible in the input perspective image, whereas vague or incomplete descriptions may lead to less coherent or less controllable generations.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，准确且详细的字幕能够提供明显更强的语义引导，尤其是对于输入透视图像中不可见的区域；而模糊或不完整的描述可能导致生成结果连贯性较差或可控性较差。

sents.en: More fundamentally, generating a complete 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} environment from a single perspective observation is inherently under-constrained.
sents.zh: 更根本的是，从单一透视观测生成完整的 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 环境本质上是欠约束的。

sents.en: Content outside the observed FoV must be synthesized rather than faithfully recovered, and multiple plausible panoramas may correspond to the same input image.
sents.zh: 视场之外的内容必须通过合成来生成，而非忠实地还原，并且同一张输入图像可能对应多幅合理的全景图。

sents.en: Finally, our current study focuses on static panoramas.
sents.zh: 最后，我们目前的研究聚焦于静态全景图。

sents.en: Extending CubeAtlas to temporally consistent panoramic video and interactive scene generation remains an interesting direction for future work.
sents.zh: 将 CubeAtlas 扩展到时间上一致的全景视频和交互式场景生成，是未来工作中有趣的方向。

paragraphs.en: Our training corpus combines publicly available, internally collected, and synthetic panoramas. After quality filtering, these public sources provide approximately 50K panoramas. We further include 20K internally collected panoramas covering street scenes and indoor environments, and render 5K synthetic data from Unreal Engine assets following the pipeline in Lu et al. (2025) . Together, these sources form a training corpus of roughly 80K panoramas. We sample real and synthetic panoramas during training at an approximate ratio of 6 : 4 6{:}4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的训练语料库结合了公开获取、内部收集以及合成的全景图。 公开部分包括 PolyHaven（Poly Haven, n.d.）、Humus（Humus, n.d.）和 PanoInfinigen（Bozic et al., 2026），以及从 Mapillary（Mapillary, n.d.）收集的额外街景全景图。 经过质量过滤后，这些公开来源提供了约 5 万张全景图。 我们进一步纳入了 2 万张涵盖街景和室内环境的内部收集全景图，并按照 Lu et al. paragraphs.en: Our evaluation suite consists of three public panorama benchmarks and one self-collected image set. Specifically, we evaluate on 100 100 panoramas from RealSee3D ( Li et al., 2026 ) , 100 100 panoramas from the Laval-Indoor test set ( Gardner et al., 2017 ) , and 118 118 panoramas from the SUN360 test set ( Xiao et al., 2012 ) . For each panorama, we render a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} -FoV perspective view centered at the canonical viewing direction as the conditioning image. Gemini-3.5-Flash generates the text prompt from the complete ground-truth panorama, providing a description of both the observed and unobserved regions. This setting therefore evaluates panorama generation under relatively complete scene-level textual guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估套件由三个公开的全景基准和一个自采图像集组成。 具体而言，我们在 RealSee3D（Li et al., 2026）的 100 张全景图、Laval-Indoor 测试集（Gardner et al., 2017）的 100 张全景图以及 SUN360 测试集（Xiao et al., 2012）的 118 张全景图上进行评估。 对于每张全景图，我们以规范观察方向为中心渲染一个 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} 视场角的透视图作为条件图像。 Gemini-3.5-Flash 从完整的真值全景图生成文本提示，同时提供对已观察区域和未观察区域的描述。 因此，该设置评估的是在相对完整的场景级文本引导下的全景生成。

paragraphs.en: Training targets for Squaring-the-Sphere are constructed online in CubeAtlas space. Before VAE encoding, a 32 32 -pixel-wide strip copied from the left edge is appended to the right boundary as auxiliary horizontal context. This padding facilitates wrap-around seam handling but does not belong to the core CubeAtlas representation. During output assembly, the decoded padding context is used for boundary blending and then removed. The ERP ablation uses the same context-padding scheme for a fair comparison. Sparse attention is applied only to target-to-target interactions, while text and image-conditioning tokens remain globally connected.
paragraphs.zh: Squaring-the-Sphere 的训练目标是在 CubeAtlas 空间中在线构建的。 在 VAE 编码之前，从左边缘复制的一条宽 32×32 像素的条带会被附加到右侧边界，作为辅助的水平上下文。 这种填充有助于处理环绕接缝，但不属于核心的 CubeAtlas 表示。 在输出组装时，解码出的填充上下文用于边界融合，随后会被移除。 ERP 消融实验采用相同的上下文填充方案，以保证公平比较。 稀疏注意力仅应用于目标到目标的交互，而文本和图像条件令牌保持全局连接。

paragraphs.en: For each training panorama, we render a perspective conditioning view by uniformly sampling the FoV from [ 50 ∘ , 90 ∘ ] [50^{\circ},90^{\circ}] and the pitch angle from [ − 75 ∘ , 75 ∘ ] [-75^{\circ},75^{\circ}] , while fixing the yaw and roll angles to 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} . To improve robustness to diverse input formats, we render the conditioning image at a nominal resolution of 1024 pixels, with its aspect ratio sampled from { : 4 , : 1 , : 3 , : 9 , : 16 } \{3\!:\!4,1\!:\!1,4\!:\!3,16\!:\!9,9\!:\!16\} . For text conditioning, we use Gemini-3.5-Flash to describe the complete panorama rather than the sampled perspective view. For each panorama, we generate both a concise and a detailed caption and randomly use one of them during training, exposing the model to scene-level descriptions at different levels of granularity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张训练全景图，我们通过从 [50°, 90°] 中均匀采样视场角（FoV）、从 [−75°, 75°] 中均匀采样俯仰角来渲染一个透视条件视图，同时将偏航角和翻滚角固定为 0°。 为了提高对多样输入格式的鲁棒性，我们以 1024 像素的标称分辨率渲染条件图像，其宽高比从 {3:4, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 9:16} 中采样。 对于文本条件，我们使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 来描述完整的全景图，而不是采样得到的透视图。 对于每张全景图，我们生成简洁和详细两种描述文本，并在训练时随机使用其中之一，使模型接触不同粒度的场景级描述。

paragraphs.en: We use frozen Flux-based PiD weights ( Lu et al., 2026a ) without panorama-specific fine-tuning. To enable seamless fusion after super-resolution, the base ERP is reprojected into six overlapping perspective cubemap views by slightly enlarging the FoV to 92.79 ∘ 92.79^{\circ} . Each view has a spatial resolution of 672 × 672 672\times 672 , where the additional context beyond the canonical 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} cubemap face forms the overlap regions with neighboring views. PiD independently upsamples each view by 4 × 4\times to 2688 × 2688 2688\times 2688 , so the overlap regions are enhanced together with the valid face content. The super-resolved views are then reprojected back to the ERP domain, where overlapping regions are linearly blended to suppress cross-view discontinuities. After removing the corresponding 128px boundary context, each effective cube face has a resolution of 2560 × 2560 2560\times 2560 , yielding a final ERP panorama of 5120 × 10240 5120\times 10240 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用冻结的基于 Flux 的 PiD 权重（Lu et al., 2026a），未进行全景特定的微调。 为了在超分辨率之后实现无缝融合，基础 ERP 被重投影为六个重叠的透视立方体贴图视图，并将 FoV 略微扩大到 92.79^{\circ}。 每个视图的空间分辨率为 672\times 672，其中超出标准 90^{\circ} 立方体贴图面的额外上下文构成了与相邻视图的重叠区域。 PiD 将每个视图独立地上采样 4\times 倍至 2688\times 2688，因此重叠区域与有效面内容一起得到增强。 超分辨率后的视图随后被重投影回 ERP 域，其中重叠区域通过线性混合来抑制跨视图的不连续性。 在去除相应的 128px 边界上下文之后，每个有效立方体面的分辨率为 2560\times 2560，最终得到 5120\times 10240 的 ERP 全景图。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a two-alternative forced-choice user study with 28 28 volunteers. Participants are divided into four groups of seven, with each group comparing Squaring-the-Sphere against one competing method. Each participant evaluates all 100 100 scenes assigned to their group, resulting in 700 700 valid comparisons per competing method and 2,800 2{,}800 comparisons in total. Each trial requires a binary preference with no tie option. For all methods, we use the base-resolution outputs without super-resolution. Compared methods are produced using their official implementations and inference settings. In each trial, participants are shown the conditioning image and text prompt together with two anonymized panorama results presented in randomized left–right order. Both panoramas can be freely explored using an interactive 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} viewer. Participants are asked to select the better result by jointly considering conditioning fidelity, visual quality, boundary continuity, and polar geometry. As shown in Figure 8 , Squaring-the-Sphere is preferred over CubeDiff, DreamCube, HunyuanPano, and HY-Pano-2.0 in 96.7 % 96.7\% , 99.7 % 99.7\% , 85.7 % 85.7\% , and 63.0 % 63.0\% of comparisons, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项针对28名志愿者的二选一强迫选择用户研究。 参与者被分为四组，每组七人，每组将 Squaring-the-Sphere 与一种竞争方法进行比较。 每位参与者评估分配到其所在组的全部100个场景，每种竞争方法共得到700次有效比较，总计2,800次比较。 每次试验需要做出二元偏好选择，没有平局选项。 对于所有方法，我们均使用不经过超分辨率的基准分辨率输出。 竞争方法均使用其官方实现与推理设置生成。 在每次试验中，参与者会看到条件图像和文本提示，以及以随机左右顺序呈现的两个匿名化全景结果。 两幅全景图均可通过交互式360°查看器自由探索。 参与者被要求综合考虑条件保真度、视觉质量、边界连续性和极点几何，选出更好的结果。 如图8所示，在比较中，Squaring-the-Sphere 分别以96.7%、99.7%、85.7%和63.0%的比例被优先选择于 CubeDiff、DreamCube、HunyuanPano 和 HY-Pano-2.0。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate image-to-panorama generation along four complementary dimensions: distributional fidelity, boundary continuity, regional perceptual and geometric quality, and text adherence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个互补的维度上评估图像到全景图的生成：分布保真度、边界连续性、区域感知与几何质量，以及文本遵循度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate distributional fidelity using FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , KID ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) , and CLIP-FID ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2023 ) . Because their feature encoders are trained on perspective images, we compute these metrics on tangent perspective views rather than directly on ERP panoramas. For each benchmark, both generated and ground-truth panoramas are resized to the native resolution of the ground-truth set and rendered into 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} square views centered at the 12 12 vertices of a regular icosahedron. All rendered views are pooled at the dataset level for metric computation. FID and KID use Inception-V3 features, while CLIP-FID uses CLIP ViT-B/32 features; all metrics are computed with clean-fid Parmar et al. (2022) , with lower values indicating better performance. KID is reported without additional scaling.

paragraphs.en: Eq-IQ and Pole-IQ correspond to the “Image Quality” criterion, which asks for the overall quality of each equatorial view or polar close-up. Eq-Aes corresponds to “Aesthetic”, which asks how visually pleasing each equatorial view is. Eq-GI and Pole-GI correspond to the “Distortion” criterion in the respective regional prompts and are reported as geometric integrity for clarity, without changing the numerical scores. Higher scores indicate fewer distortion-related visual artifacts. For Eq-GI, the prompt asks whether the view resembles a normal camera photo, with wavy or rippling lines, melted or broken objects, and shimmering moire or banding on regular textures lowering the score. For Pole-GI, the prompt asks whether the pole converges naturally and identifies swirl or vortex patterns, central black holes, radial cracks or seams, warped geometry, smearing, and nadir camera or tripod patches as defects. Thus, these criteria cover the specified geometric and structural artifacts as well as texture artifacts or polar patches, rather than a purely geometric reconstruction error. For each regional criterion, we first average scores over the corresponding views within each panorama, then over panoramas.
paragraphs.zh: Eq-IQ 和 Pole-IQ 对应“图像质量”准则，该准则评估每个赤道视角或极点特写的整体质量。 Eq-Aes 对应“美学”准则，该准则评估每个赤道视角在视觉上的美观程度。 Eq-GI 和 Pole-GI 分别在对应的区域提示中对应“失真”准则，为清晰起见被报告为几何完整性，数值分数保持不变。 分数越高表示失真相关的视觉伪影越少。 对于 Eq-GI，提示询问该视角是否类似普通相机照片，波浪状或涟漪状的线条、融化或破碎的物体，以及规则纹理上闪烁的摩尔纹或条带都会降低分数。 对于 Pole-GI，提示询问极点是否自然汇聚，并将漩涡或涡流图案、中心黑洞、放射状裂缝或接缝、扭曲的几何形状、拖影，以及天底处的相机或三脚架补丁视为缺陷。 因此，这些准则涵盖了特定的几何和结构伪影以及纹理伪影或极点补丁，而非纯粹的几何重建误差。 对于每个区域准则，我们先在每个全景图内对相应视角的分数取平均，再在全景图之间取平均。

The prompt asks the judge to assess only whether the visible content matches the description, considering objects, attributes, counts, and spatial relations. Its anchors range from all described elements being present and correct (5), through minor omissions or small mismatches (4), several missing or incorrect elements (3), and most of the description being unsatisfied (2), to a scene nearly unrelated to the prompt (1). Scores are averaged over samples with non-empty prompts. The scoring prompts are provided below.

paragraphs.en: To validate the VLM-based evaluation, we sample 10 test cases and select outputs from three randomly chosen methods per case, yielding 30 panoramas that collectively cover CubeDiff, DreamCube, HunyuanPano, HY-Pano-2.0, and our method. Three independent raters, blinded to method identities and VLM scores, evaluate each panorama on Eq-IQ, Eq-Aes, Pole-IQ, Eq-GI, Pole-GI, and TextAdh using a five-point scale. Regional panels are rated as a whole. We average the three human ratings to obtain a mean opinion score (MOS) for each panorama and criterion. For each criterion, we compute Spearman’s rank correlation across the 30 panoramas between MOS and the corresponding panorama-level VLM scores. As shown in Table 3 , VLM scores correlate strongly with human judgments across all six criteria, with ρ \rho ranging from 0.7698 0.7698 to 0.9358 0.9358 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证基于 VLM 的评估方法，我们抽取了 10 个测试用例，并从每个用例中随机选取三种方法的输出，共得到 30 张全景图，这些全景图总体上覆盖了 CubeDiff、DreamCube、HunyuanPano、HY-Pano-2.0 以及我们的方法。 三位独立的评分者在不知道方法身份和 VLM 分数的情况下，采用五分制对每张全景图在 Eq-IQ、Eq-Aes、Pole-IQ、Eq-GI、Pole-GI 和 TextAdh 上进行评估。 各区域面板作为整体进行评分。 我们对三次人工评分取平均，得到每张全景图在每项准则下的平均意见分数（MOS）。 对于每项准则，我们在这 30 张全景图上计算 MOS 与对应的全景级 VLM 分数之间的 Spearman 秩相关。 如表 3 所示，VLM 分数在全部六项准则上都与人工判断高度相关，ρ 的取值范围从 0.7698 到 0.9358。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 compares a full-polar variant of Squaring-the-Sphere with the half-polar design adopted in our final model. The full-polar variant retains a complete orientation-aligned copy of each polar face above and below every equatorial face, resulting in a fully occupied grid. Compared with the half-polar design, this increases the token count by 50 % 50\% and incurs approximately 37 % 37\% higher computational cost (even enhanced by the sparse attention). All quality metrics and efficiency measurements in Table 4 are evaluated on the self-collected benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 表4比较了「平方化球」的全极变体与我们最终模型采用的半极设计。 全极变体在每张赤道面的上方和下方都保留一份完整的、与朝向对齐的极面副本，从而形成一个完全占满的网格。 与半极设计相比，这使token数量增加了50% 50\%，并带来约37% 37\%更高的计算成本（即使有稀疏注意力增强也是如此）。 表4中的所有质量指标和效率测量均在自建基准上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Despite its substantially higher computational cost, the full-polar variant does not yield a clear improvement over the half-polar design across the evaluated metrics. This suggests that retaining only the equator-adjacent halves already provides sufficient polar context for high-quality panorama generation, while avoiding the redundancy introduced by complete polar copies. The half-polar packing therefore offers a superior quality-and-efficiency trade-off and is adopted in our final design.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管其计算开销显著更高，但在所有评估指标上，全极地变体相较于半极地设计并未带来明显的提升。 这表明仅保留赤道相邻的半部分已足以为高质量的全景图生成提供充分的极地上下文，同时避免了完整极地副本所引入的冗余。 因此，半极地打包提供了更优的质量与效率权衡，并被采纳为我们的最终设计。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 demonstrates the versatility of our geometry-free formulation across perspective inputs with varying FoV and viewing directions, including upward- and downward-looking images. Rather than relying on camera calibration or explicitly projecting the input onto a predefined panoramic coordinate system, Squaring-the-Sphere learns from data to infer the input view’s placement in the panorama and synthesize its surrounding content accordingly. Red outlines mark the regions in the generated ERPs that correspond to the input views.
paragraphs.zh: 图12展示了我们免几何参数的公式在不同视场角和观察方向的透视输入上的通用性，包括朝上和朝下拍摄的图像。 Squaring-the-Sphere 不依赖相机标定，也不将输入显式投影到预定义的全景坐标系中，而是从数据中学习来推断输入视图在全景图中的位置，并据此合成其周围内容。 红色轮廓标出了生成的等距柱状全景图中与输入视图对应的区域。
